name: publish_module
description: Validate a lani.module/v0 spec and publish it to the app as a new version. Returns validation errors instead of publishing if the spec is invalid. Load the lani-studio skill before using. Say the learner {learner} and what agrees with them {m:…|f:…} (companion/SCENES.md, the learner in the content). The explain of an exercise is markdown, shown after the answer: one bold rule line ("**dela** → no **-m**, no **-š** → *on/ona*"), then the examples as a list ("- delam · I work") or a mini table, endings in bold, at most ~3 lines (module-spec.md, "Explanations").

spec.description: The module spec (lani.module/v0). The bridge assigns the version.

note.description: One-line changelog shown in the app
